tasks.goal: Build a Node CLI tool that converts a CSV file to JSON via command-line arguments and manually verify a few sample invocations. As a FINAL SEPARATE PHASE, add a package.json and a README documenting those exact verified invocations under a 'Verified invocations' section.

Write and boot a zero-dependency Node HTTP JSON API for managing a small library's book inventory (add, list, update, delete books) using only the built-in http module, with an in-memory store and a startup port log line.

Build a single-file Node JSON CRUD API for a recipe collection (create, read, list, delete recipes) with a README spec of its routes. As a FINAL SEPARATE PHASE, mechanically exercise every documented route end-to-end and confirm status codes and response bodies match the spec.
Build a self-contained index.html mood-tracker widget with buttons to log a mood and a display area whose background color and message change conditionally based on the currently selected mood state.

Build a self-contained HTML/JS habit-streak widget with increment/reset controls and conditional styling that exposes its internal state via a window.__habitWidget object with getters. As a FINAL SEPARATE PHASE, mechanically verify the controls and styling by reading and exercising that exposed state object.

Write and verify a no-dependency Node CLI that reads a single temperature argument like '30C' or '86F' from process.argv[2], converts it to the other scale, and exits 1 with a stderr usage message when the argument is missing or malformed.

Build a single-file Node HTTP JSON API server for managing a personal task list (create, list, update status, delete tasks). As a FINAL SEPARATE PHASE, write a README documenting every route, request body, and status code exactly as implemented in the server's source code, without probing it live.

Write a README.md and CONTRIBUTING.md for a hypothetical 'data-pipeline' command-line project with specified required headings (Overview, Installation, Usage, Contributing Guidelines, Code of Conduct), plus a config.json file containing an exact specified literal set of pipeline stage names and settings.
